Collectible footballs shaped by Italian hands, genuine calfskin and years of uncompromising craftsmanship.

A football can hold more than air. It can carry the memory of a club, the date that changed everything, and the unmistakable trace of the hands that made it. COSPEX transforms the game’s most familiar object into an heirloom.
Each piece is made to enquiry, individually numbered and accompanied by its record of authenticity.
